events.title: Avatar Display Size Increased
events.description: Following the avatar file size increase to 150KB, Omniscient noticed the in-thread display size had never been updated after the old jump from 100x100 to 120x150. Avatars on posts now render at the full 120x150 dimensions.

events.title: Mailing List / Newsletter
events.description: Omniscient asked for feedback on an opt-in weekly email newsletter covering hot threads, announcements, and community highlights.

events.title: JS Adjustments
events.description: Omniscient minified two of HF's custom JavaScript files to cut page load size; members were asked to report any issues with tabs, convos, or notifications.

events.title: Vibe $250 Crypto Giveaway - Crack The Seed V4
events.description: Kingsman announced Crack the Seed V4: $250 of SOL locked in a wallet, with 12 daily riddles each revealing part of the seed phrase. The first to unlock the wallet claims the prize; applications open for 7 days.

events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to 크러쉬가. Rat Expert awarded to Binance.

events.title: Group & Crew Changes
events.description: 5chn4pp and Unknown were added as leaders of Equilibrium.

events.title: [Release] HF News Archive Project
events.description: xadamxk put together an offsite archive covering hundreds of HF News editions, thousands of events, notable threads, awards, group activity, and contributors, all searchable through a web viewer.

events.title: What are we doing
events.description: ModernEHustle opened up about feeling lost and stressed, and the replies became a grounded discussion about purpose, money, social pressure, faith, mental health, and finding direction.

events.title: [DISCUSSION] Does anyone feel life after 2020 has completely changed?
events.description: Mastercarder pointed to the social, financial, and cultural shifts since 2020 (rising prices, short-form content, weaker social habits) and asked whether technology now uses us more than we use it.

events.title: If you'll give your son 1 advice what would it be?
events.description: A simple question that turned into a collection of life lessons on ownership, family, money, relationships, bad habits, regret, and self-respect.

events.title: Finally coming to United States of America
events.description: Adolfi asked for five places to visit on a 30-day first trip to the US; members suggested Miami, Las Vegas, national parks, NYC and more, alongside warnings about customs and electronics.

events.title: You're not crazy, more than half of adults are borderline retarded
events.description: Hackers brought up adult literacy statistics and tied them to online arguments, scams, short attention spans, and dopamine-driven content, arguing comprehension is becoming a major filter online.

events.title: What was your first job, what was it like, and what recommendations would you give?
events.description: TheNaturalBoy asked members about their first jobs; replies covered retail, food service, accounting, and regrets about spending early paychecks instead of saving.
